purpose.zh: 练胸部和手臂，比普通俯卧撑下得更深
purpose.en: Build your chest and arms with a deeper push-up.

text.zh: 胸口沉到两手之间，手肘斜向后
text.en: Sink your chest between your hands with elbows angled back

text.zh: 推起后手臂伸直，再把地往下推远一点。
text.en: At the top, straighten your arms and push the floor a little further away.

text.zh: 身体保持一条直线，别塌腰。
text.en: Keep your body in one straight line without sagging.

commonErrors.en: Going so deep that the shoulders roll forward.

cautions.zh: 肩前面夹着疼时，下浅一点
cautions.en: If the front of your shoulder pinches, do not go as deep.
Stop if your wrists hurt or go numb.

changes: 主口令去掉「45°」数字，改「手肘斜向后」；cue2「肩胛向前推」改成口语「把地往下推远一点」
口令按相位缩短（沉下去 0.8 s / 推起 0.6 s）；cautions 改短句
flags: 批表底部停 0.7 s，spec 写底部只停 0.25 s，按批表取值
